## Transcend MTE255S 1TB PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSD

1TB PCIe Gen4 x4 NVMe Up to 7,400MB/s M.2 2280 · Graphene Heatsink

The Transcend MTE255S 1TB, part number TS1TMTE255S, is a value-focused PCIe Gen4 internal M.2 2280 NVMe SSD with an integrated graphene heatsink, designed for the PlayStation 5, desktops and laptops. With sequential reads up to 7,400MB/s, it offers near top-tier Gen4 speed while the slim graphene layer keeps temperatures in check without adding bulk — ideal as a fast, affordable boot or game drive.

Delivering sequential reads up to 7,400MB/s and writes up to 5,200MB/s, the MTE255S handles gaming and everyday tasks with ease. Carrying EAN 0760557870890 and MPN TS1TMTE255S, it uses 3D TLC NAND in a single-sided DRAM-less design with LDPC error correction, a 600TBW endurance rating and a 5-year limited warranty.

Compatibility note

The MTE255S uses the standard M.2 2280 size (22 x 80mm) with a PCIe NVMe slot, and is single-sided. Its thin graphene heatsink fits the PlayStation 5’s storage bay and most laptops and desktops — unlike thick metal heatsinks, it stays slim enough for handhelds and notebooks. It runs at full speed in Gen4 slots and works in Gen3 slots at reduced speed.

...

### Key Features

PCIe Gen4 speeds up to 7,400MB/s

Sequential reads up to 7,400MB/s and writes up to 5,200MB/s, for fast boots, quick game loads and smooth file transfers — among the quicker Gen4 drives in its class.

Integrated graphene heatsink

A thin graphene heat spreader plus dynamic thermal throttling keeps the drive cool under load, while staying low-profile enough for the PS5, laptops and slim systems.
